title: SebaoPL Lite Pack
description: A custom collection of 150 mods optimized for every-end hardware
body:
A custom collection of 150+ mods meticulously optimized for every-end hardware. Focus on technical stability and high-speed gameplay while maintaining the best performance on Fabric 1.20.1.

⚙️ Performance: Powered by C2ME, Sodium, and Starlight for ultra-fast chunk loading and high FPS. 🛡️ Stability: Includes Packet Fixer and MixinTrace to prevent crashes and networking errors. 🛠️ Quality of Life: Polymorph for recipe conflicts and Inventory HUD+ for real-time equipment tracking. ✨ Visuals: Fully compatible with Iris Shaders and CIT Resewn for advanced resource packs. 🎮 Controller-friendly: Fully optimized for smooth interactions and a modern Minecraft experience.

Optimized for Fabric 1.20.1. Perfect for players who want a fast, stable, and smooth experience on any rig.
